provenance.revision_note: Live runs used an earlier observer revision. client_control: PTY ETX delivered SIGINT to the opencode run process; it exited 130. No OpenCode session-interrupt API or in-process HTTP-abort hook was used. Observer-side socket EOF occurred after process exit and does not establish an OpenCode HTTP-library abort.

observer.role: loopback HTTP relay; forwarded original request body bytes unchanged to the Responses endpoint
observer.capture: allowlisted request/event metadata only; no auth values, prompts, or payload text
observer.upstream_cancellation_evidence: observer detected downstream socket EOF and closed its OpenAI HTTPS connection; remote compute cancellation is not observable

limitations: Direct leg used two attempts (the card maximum); its first attempt did not retain final transport evidence.
No terminal usage was reported for interrupted streams; token usage and remote compute/billing effects are unknown.
PTY SIGINT terminated the CLI process. Subsequent socket EOF and observer upstream close do not prove an in-client HTTP abort or remote provider compute cancellation.
